data.spiritual_meaning: Eleutherius expresses “Free, liberated”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eleutherius total 53, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: Eleutherius
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eleutherius הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word eleutheria, meaning 'freedom, liberty'. In Christian tradition, St. Eleutherius was a bishop and martyr in Illyria.
